record.paper: Separation choosability and dense bipartite induced subgraphs

dossier_meta.paper: Separation choosability and dense bipartite induced subgraphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: There are functions $x_2(d)$ and $x_3(d)$ satisfying $x_2(d) \to \infty$ and $x_3(d) \to \infty$ as $d \to \infty$ such that any graph with minimum degree at least $d$ contains a complete subgraph on $x_2(d)$ vertices or a bipartite induced subgraph with minimum degree at least $x_3(d)$.
dossier_meta.context_text: This conjecture, if true, would imply Conjecture 1.3: since $\mathrm{ch}_{\mathrm{sep}}(K_{d+1}) \sim \sqrt{d}$ (Kratochvíl–Tuza–Voigt) and Theorem 1.2 handles the dense bipartite induced subgraph case, the two alternatives together would give a separation-choosability lower bound tending to infinity for any graph of large minimum degree.
